segments.contextBefore: Add a widget extension to your App Clip target and use ActivityKit to display Live Activities on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
segments.contextAfter: With Live Activities, you can display live event data on the iPhone Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island on supported devices.

segments.contextAfter: Your App Clip can’t typically include app extensions, but starting with iOS 16 you can include a widget extension that offers Live Activities and displays live event data without requiring people to install your full app.
